research_question: Does a local-only project evidence journal provide two defensible paid advantages over free Windows note apps?

sources.name: Obsidian File Recovery
sources.implication: Snapshot history, before/after comparison, and local restore alone are not unique paid advantages.

sources.name: Joplin Note History
verified_claims: Free desktop note revisions saved at intervals
Desktop view and restore of older versions
sources.implication: Note revisions and restore are already covered by a strong free alternative.

sources.name: Joplin Backup plugin FAQ
verified_claims: JEX backup does not include note revision history
sources.implication: A human-readable project export containing selected note revisions could address a documented portability gap, but does not establish paid demand.

sources.name: Myelin Notes
verified_claims: Windows support and free personal use
Per-file version history and PDF export
sources.implication: Offline, no account, note history, and PDF export also overlap with free products.
sources.caveat: Vendor feature claims only; not independently installed.

sources.name: Ariv
verified_claims: Free local-first Markdown notes on Windows
Built-in tasks, calendar, Kanban and search
sources.implication: A broad productivity/notes bundle cannot justify a price on feature count alone.
sources.caveat: Vendor feature claims only; not independently installed.

sources.name: TSNotes
verified_claims: Local JSON notes, version history, restore, and offline operation
sources.implication: One-time payment is plausible in adjacent notes software, but existing paid product has more general-purpose features.
sources.caveat: Price is vendor list price, not Store transaction or verified sales volume.

comparison.paid_reference: TSNotes USD 10 one-time (vendor advertised; not comparable verified Store sale)

candidate_distinctions.hypothesis: Project-scoped narrative event timeline linking each note change to explicit user-entered event/reason and selected source references
candidate_distinctions.competitive_status: UNVERIFIED: compare against Obsidian templates/plugins and Joplin plugins
candidate_distinctions.implementation_constraint: Never claim immutable, tamper-proof, or compliance-certified logs

candidate_distinctions.hypothesis: Single human-readable offline project handover bundle containing selected revisions, timeline, and restore preview without cloud/account
candidate_distinctions.competitive_status: POSSIBLE GAP: Joplin JEX does not include revisions, but alternatives/plugins must be checked
candidate_distinctions.implementation_constraint: No arbitrary file hashing/snapshot duplication of File Integrity Ledger

buyer_persona_hypothesis: Independent Windows field auditor or restricted-network operations worker handing a human-readable project chronology to a colleague
why_pay_statement: NOT PROVEN: no verified buyer demand for revision-aware project handover compared with free note tools and plugins.

price_hypothesis.status: UNVALIDATED; do not launch or represent as a validated willingness-to-pay

risk: A general notes app cannot compete on feature breadth; project evidence handover must be tested as a separate workflow, not merely renamed.
required_next_evidence: Capture 10 dated and directly linked Microsoft Store competitor reviews, separating verified purchaser complaints from developer claims
Interview at least 5 target buyers and ask them to compare a manual Obsidian/Joplin workflow against an evidence-bundle prototype
Build a noncommercial paper/clickable prototype for project timeline and revision-inclusive export, then test task completion at 1024x768 in JA and EN
Audit free Obsidian/Joplin plugins and template workflows for the same evidence export before claiming differentiation
Only after independent evidence re-score all seven rubric categories; do not auto-upgrade to MARKET_FIT_PASS
provenance: Official documentation and vendor pages inspected 2026-10-30; no buyer interviews, Store reviews, or Windows installs were performed in this research run.
